purpose: Determine whether the official BMB reef-fish reference-material link supplies the underlying site-resolved Batanes CARE-CaDRES assessment checklist.

source.title: Guidelines on the Assessment of Coastal and Marine Ecosystems (BMB Technical Bulletin No. 2017-05)
source.provider: Biodiversity Management Bureau, Department of Environment and Natural Resources
source.citation: Biodiversity Management Bureau. (2017, February 8). Guidelines on the Assessment of Coastal and Marine Ecosystems (BMB Technical Bulletin No. 05). Department of Environment and Natural Resources.

accessCheck.officialAnnex: The official BMB eLibrary indexed text for Annex 1 lists Reef Fish Identification and data processing, Fish Visual Census, a Reef Fish Identification Manual, and “Sample reef fish data.”
accessCheck.retrievalOutcome: The linked folder returned file-not-found (404) through the connected Drive fetch tool; the web tool could not open Drive folders. The official BMB PDF endpoints also did not return readable content in this pass; the official indexed annex excerpt was reviewed.
accessCheck.limitation: These access failures do not establish that the folder was deleted or unavailable to the public. Its contents and permissions remain unverified.

comparison.batanesAssessment: The UP MSI 2024 chapter reports an October 2017 reef assessment at eight stations across five Batanes municipalities and 161 fish species in aggregate.
comparison.relationshipToSample: Neither the BMB annex nor its indexed text identifies the generic sample data as the CARE-CaDRES Batanes 2017 dataset, names Batanes stations, or links sample rows to the UP MSI assessment.
comparison.speciesListStatus: No Batanes checklist, species-by-station matrix, voucher list, or station coordinate table was retrieved from this BMB material.

limits: The BMB bulletin is a methods and reference-material lead, not evidence that any sample file contains Batanes survey observations.
Do not use generic sample rows to infer Batanes species, station occurrence, abundance, habitat, diet, catchability, regulations, or safety.
No file from the linked Drive folder was downloaded, copied, or inspected; the folder contents and reuse terms are unresolved.
The underlying Batanes chapter remains aggregate-only. Keep its 161-species total separate from individual taxon or site assertions.
nextAction: Continue the Batanes source search for an explicitly linked CARE-CaDRES field checklist, fish-by-station table, voucher-linked dataset, or supplementary material. Treat the BMB “Sample reef fish data” only as a generic methods/sample lead unless its original file proves otherwise.
